totalTime.description: aggregate "wall" time of all the steps

time.description: wall time of a run - if steps are running in multiple threads this time is going to be less then totalTime

totalCpu.description: approximate CPU time used across all JVM threads while test was running

cpu.description: aggregate cpu time as reported by test action

dbTime.description: aggregate dbTime as reported by test action

measurements.description: custom measurement aggregates from step() go here
